sources: R-087 (pending ledger row; reserved by Main for amendment adoption)

supersedes_on_adoption.only_removed_requirement: Capture all child-process starts and argv; this is replaced, not silently waived, by the four-layer deterministic proof below. Signed v1 bytes are preserved.

fixtures: Synthetic repository with differing commit/parent policies, nonempty scanner issue IDs, and deliberately enabled model settings before the binding is applied.

django/django pinned tip a05e16a7230fe33d3f43f4a3aaed103cebb42efc and its first parent. Resolve and seal the exact parent SHA after authorised object fetch, before acceptance. No moving refs or substituted pair.
binding_requirement: Bind policy loading at both commit and parent; a working-directory file alone is not an override because policy.Load reads base-ref policy. Preserve scanner/rule/tool/evidence bytes and issue identity.
required_checks_per_fixture: Before invoking any fixture scanner, resolve and seal the exact effective configuration for parent and head. Emit a faithful, credential-free representation of the engine.Config and engine.Options actually passed to Assess (or to the structurally separate scanner-only reference), not just intended policy. Require decisions.enabled=false, model_cli.lanes=[], mapping.association.enabled=false, nil association options, heuristic-only mapping, both Clawpatch and contextual egress unauthorized, ranking absent and no PR-metadata-fetch path. Later execution must emit byte-identical effective records. A nonempty or inconsistent setting refuses before scanners.

Record the actual engine lane report. Contextual, Clawpatch-review and association-fallback must be skipped, never ran/reused/blocked/failed; contextual/review coverage rows must be skipped with reason not opted in when jobs exist. Association and its fallback must report disabled. Jev ranking/decision stages are structurally absent and policy decisions are off. Empty/missing/duplicate model-lane reports cannot pass. The reference reports these stages structurally absent rather than fabricating engine execution.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY is absent at controller entry and each frontend launch; record only its presence boolean, never its value or environment contents. Use a private allowlisted environment and empty private HOME/XDG directories. Logging-and-failing claude/codex stand-ins are first on PATH and at every supported configured executable path, including CLAWPATCH_CLAUDE_BIN. The pinned Codex provider resolves literal codex on PATH: it has no CLAWPATCH_CODEX_BIN override. Its supported CLAWPATCH_CODEX_SANDBOX is read-only, never bypass/none; no inherited CLAWPATCH_CODEX_* value can redirect or weaken the guard. Bound and reference attempt logs must be empty. No real model CLI may run, even for --version.

Synthetic-only positive control: keep the key absent and deliberately do not apply the binding. Both revision policies have model settings enabled; exercise parent/claude and head/codex paths using only the failing stand-ins. Require genuine stand-in log entries containing executable identity, argv, PID and the stand-in's fixed failure status. Require expected production provider argv, nonzero stub exit and rejection by the very same no-model interlock used for bound runs. Resolution-only calls must not create model attempts. Django acceptance must bind the already-passing sealed synthetic receipt; never enable a model lane on Django for this control.

Compare sorted complete issue-identity sets and multiplicities to a scanner-only reference without the override at both parent and head. Identity contains family, sanitized category, rule version, complete AnchorOf and primary path/start-line/start-byte; verify real bound-store provenance links and disclose carried durable IDs. Require nonempty exact equality, never intersections/count-only equality. Require identical pinned scanner/rule/tool inputs, effective scanner batches, accounted coverage, normalized omissions/mapping gaps and the same key/stand-in interlock. Do not invoke model-enabled decision stages for this reference. Preserve independent fresh parent-to-head state lifecycles and equal-byte-length bound/reference roots. Synthetic parent/head finding sets must differ.
scratch_rehearsal: The first scoped zero-issue v2 review authorizes only a noncanonical synthetic rehearsal using the same reviewed runtime, installed closure, routes and interlock. It writes only beneath SCRATCH, never opens/reserves OUT/binding/*, never creates a Journal, and is never a seal producer. Its report exposes complete per-route occurrence keys/multiplicity, scanner health/reasons, stand-in attempts and the acceptance predicate outcome without asserting an acceptance pass. Before canonical synthetic reservation, require OUT/reviews/binding-v2-rehearsal.json, scope model-free-binding-v2-rehearsal, containing an authentic zero-issue signed review binding the actual passing-predicate rehearsal report plus its source/runtime pins. Missing or stale rehearsal authority must not consume the canonical attempt.
required_sealed_evidence: Authentic scoped preparation authority and new zero-issue rule-5 amendment authority; fixture source and exact commit/parent SHAs; all source/runtime/scanner/policy digests; commands and timestamps; unchanged canonical 45-day preparation clock

Unbound synthetic resolved configuration showing model settings enabled and genuine positive-control stand-in argv/failure/interlock rejection; bound resolved actual Config/Options at both revisions, key-absence boolean, actual engine lane reports, empty bound/reference stand-in attempt logs and exact complete issue-identity/multiplicity equality for each fixture

Installed hash-pinned closure revalidated immediately before each resolution/execution, source-materialization drift checks, real fixture outputs, immutable evidence pins and passing scoped review records; no JSON approval flag substitutes for the records
residual_limitation: This is proof about audited model seams under emitted configuration, not global process observation. Pinned scanner binaries are trusted not to hide model calls, backed by hash-pinned installed closure and Scout's fail-closed analyzer network sandbox. Scanner environments rebuild PATH, so the controller stand-ins do not reach sandboxed scanner descendants. Separately, the frontend, Node/Clawpatch dependency tree and its git/go-list children run unsandboxed with network available. Their model-freeness rests on the cited non-transitive source audit, hash-pinned closure and configured stand-ins, not on the analyzer sandbox or descendant observation; unexpected absolute-path launches are not globally observed. Positive-control liveness is demonstrated only at Scout's contextual seam. Clawpatch provider routes are configured and statically checked but not exercised by that control: their exclusion rests on empty opt-in lanes, unauthorized egress and heuristic mapping with a null provider, with stand-ins as defense in depth. Empty logs alone are insufficient; all four layers and these trust assumptions are required. No guarantee against malicious pinned software or compromised OS/hardware is claimed.
refusal: Any missing, stale, substituted, failed or unmeasured check refuses frame/dev scans and inventory advancement. Fixture output cannot be used as collected inventory or sample-selection evidence. Privilege absence is no longer an execution prerequisite because no observer is launched; missing amendment sign-off remains a hard refusal.
